text:
natalie: Pinging the thread for TidalWave RFI. I dropped capability_matrix.xlsx and rfi_answers_draft.docx to /deals/tidalwave/rfi. Buyer needs: POC throughput numbers, on-prem HSM options, VPC peering diagram, and three pricing bands + a single-month dedicated POC fee. Can sec/ops/finance review the draft wording by EOD Fri?

ryan: Finance here. They asked for bands at 25k, 250k, and 2M tokens/mo and a one-month dedicated POC flat fee. I'll sketch rough numbers once we lock any enterprise add-ons (private control plane, BYO-HSM).

ishaan: Ops note: baseline POC throughput depends on model family and prompt length. Suggested safe figures to include in the RFI: 13B-family on 4xA100 ~ 380 req/s (16 token avg); 70B-family on 8xA100 equiv ~ 87 req/s. I'll paste a tiny CSV with assumptions.

beth: Security: HSM/KMS boilerplate we should reuse across RFIs: Private = customer-supplied HSM via PKCS#11 with attestation guidance; Dedicated = cloud KMS/CMEK (customer-managed keys); Hosted = cloud KMS integration only (we do not retain raw key material). I'll add a one-line FedRAMP controls pointer.

contracts-bot: Reminder: TidalWave RFI due 2025-07-07 17:00 UTC. Attach final artifacts to /deals/tidalwave/rfi/FINAL for audit.

ishaan: CSV (paste):

```
model,instance,baseline_reqs_s,burst_reqs_s,notes
tdw-13b,4xA100,380,700,16 token avg; warmed KV cache
tdw-70b,8xA100,87,160,16 token avg; large-context optimizations
embed-fast,2xA100,1250,2000,embedding-only workload
```

beth: Draft HSM paragraph (paste):

"Private deployments: support customer-provided HSMs via PKCS#11-compatible interfaces. We provide integration guidance, sample attestation scripts, and recommended key rotation cadence; the customer retains key lifecycle responsibility. Dedicated deployments support cloud KMS/CMEK with customer-held keys. Hosted deployments integrate with cloud KMS only and do not persist raw key material. For FIPS-validated HSM requirements, Private deployment is recommended."

ryan: Buyer also flagged two blockers: 1) legal wants a proposed egress liability cap and sample clause; 2) infra wants a POC->production handover runbook. Who will own the runbook?

ishaan: Ops will own the runbook. I'll draft a 2-page runbook with warmup steps, autoscale commands, and a handover checklist (metrics, alert thresholds, config diffs). Will include `kubectl` examples for toggling autoscaler min/max.

natalie: Good. For pricing: call out add-ons as separate line items (private control plane flat fee, BYO-HSM integration fee, region lock). That helps avoid overloading the token-band numbers.

ryan: Tentative pricing approach: hosted base, dedicated +20-25% premium depending on commitment, private control plane as one-time setup + monthly surcharge. I'll post a draft table by Thu. Also proposing a POC-month flat fee $12k as a starting point.

beth: Contracts sample egress clause draft: "Customer liability for egress-related direct damages during the POC period shall be capped at the greater of $50,000 or three (3) months of the expected subscription fees, subject to final legal review and regional law. Indirect, special, or consequential damages remain excluded per standard terms." Please run this by Legal.

contracts-bot: Flag: clause requires Legal approval; some APAC customers need alternate language.

natalie: Two content asks for the matrix: 1) clearly label rows that are "operational caveats" (quantization loss, fallback routing), 2) include a fallback sentence: "If Dedicated capacity is unavailable, requests may be routed to a compatible hosted variant, which may affect latency and SLA." Mark that as a caveat.

ishaan: Will annotate the matrix. Also note: for EU residency we can pin Dedicated/Private to eu-west-1 via routing policy, but control plane (console/analytics) defaults to our control plane unless the customer purchases a private control plane add-on. I'll add that line to the data residency answer.

ryan: Action items summary: 
- beth: finalize HSM paragraph + FedRAMP pointer (due Wed EOD)
- ishaan: finalize throughput CSV + runbook draft (due Wed noon)
- ryan: post pricing bands + add-on line items + POC-month fee draft (due Thu EOD)
- natalie: assemble final rfi_answers_draft.docx and start internal sign-off thread (due Fri morning)

natalie: Scheduling a 30m readthrough Fri 09:30. If anything blocks, flag it here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
